contents.Text: [[[hyperlink:yt-dlp][https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp]]] is an external programme used to download and parse certain information.

contents.Header2: Why use yt-dlp instead of making my own?

contents.Text: yt-dlp has thousands of people working on it to keep it up to date, which one sole developer could never do.
That is why yt-dlp is used, for flexibility across supported websites, and this will keep this programme relevant for a long time.
Args are passed to yt-dlp in order for it to know what/how to download.
Here are links to pages in the yt-dlp wiki to read about args:

rows: Getting an idea of how it works
More flags useful to understand the default args

contents.Text: [[[warning:Note:]]] From this point onwards, it assumes you have used yt-dlp before and understand how to interface with it.
•Look at the default args in the [[[button:Advanced Settings][/Main Window/Settings/Config/Advanced Settings]]] page, which contains the default args and all the information about them.
•Look at the args on the site, then add or remove the args you want, testing them in the command line/terminal beforehand.
This allows you to customise the args to fit your needs. You can even hardcode formats into the args.
You can download MP4 by using [[[strong:-f mp4]]] in the args, then use that on a playlist you want to download in MP4.
